questions.question: Aayush's birthday is on Monday 22 nd May. On what day of the week will be Neerav's Birthday in the same year if Neerav was born on 30 th October?
questions.questionHtml: Aayush's birthday is on Monday 22nd May. On what day of the week will be Neerav's Birthday in the same year if Neerav was born on 30th October?
questions.solution:
Aayush’s birthday → 22 May, Monday

Neerav’s birthday → 30 October

So, May has remaining → 9 Days

 June → 30 Days

 July → 31 Days

 August → 31 Days

 September → 30 Days

 October → 30 days

 Total Days → 161 Days

 Dividing 161 days by 7 (as there are 7 days in a week)

We get remainder 0

That means Neerav’s birthday will fall on the same day i.e., on Monday.

Hence, the answer is Monday.

questions.solution:
The possible combinations are:

90 + 30 + 20 + 50 = 190

90 + 30 + 50 = 170

50 + 30 + 20 = 100

But combination for 150 is not possible.

Hence, the answer is 150.

questions.question: The average of four consecutive odd numbers is 40. What is the largest number?
questions.questionHtml: The average of four consecutive odd numbers is 40. What is the largest number?
questions.solution:
Let the odd numbers be x, (x + 2), (x + 4), (x + 6)

Average of numbers = (x + x + 2 + x + 4 + x + 6)/4 = 40

⇒ 4x + 12 = 160

⇒ 4x = 148

⇒ x = 148/4 = 37

∴ Largest number = x + 6 = 37 + 6 = 43

questions.question: What is the reflection of the point (5, 3) in the line y = -2?
questions.questionHtml: What is the reflection of the point (5, 3) in the line y = -2?
questions.solution:
When a point is reflected about the x-axis, the x-coordinate remains the same and only the y-coordinate is transformed

∵ The line y = -2 is parallel to the x-axis, x-coordinate will remain the same after reflection

Now, along the y-direction, the distance between the reflected point and the line will be equal to the distance between the original point and the line

⇒ Distance between point and line along y-direction = |3 - (-2)| = |5| = 5 unit

⇒ Y-coordinate of reflection = -2 - 5 = -7

∴ The reflection point is (5, -7)

questions.question: The distance between the points (4, 8) and (k, -4) is 13. What is the value of k?
questions.questionHtml: The distance between the points (4, 8) and (k, -4) is 13. What is the value of k?
questions.solution:
According to the distance formula, the distance between two points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) can be computed as,

Distance = √[(x2 – x1)2 + (y2 – y1)2]

Given, distance between the points (4, 8) and (k, -4) is 13

⇒ (13)2 = (k – 4)2 + (–4 – 8)2

⇒ 169 = k2 + 16 – 8k + 144

⇒ k2 – 8k – 9 = 0

⇒ k2 – 9k + k – 9 = 0

⇒ k(k – 9) + 1(k – 9) = 0

⇒ (k – 9) (k + 1) = 0

⇒ k = 9, -1

∴ Value of k = -1

questions.question: D and E are points on side AB and AC of ΔABC. DE is parallel to BC. If AD : DB = 2 : 3 and area of ΔADE is 4 sq cm, what is the area (in sq cm) of quadrilateral BDEC.
questions.questionHtml: D and E are points on side AB and AC of ΔABC. DE is parallel to BC. If AD : DB = 2 : 3 and area of ΔADE is 4 sq cm, what is the area (in sq cm) of quadrilateral BDEC.
questions.solution:
The given triangle is shown below,

Given, AD ∶ DB = 2 ∶ 3

Let AD = 2x and DB = 3x

⇒ AB = AD + DB = 2x + 3x = 5x

Now, the ratio of the area of similar triangles is equal to the square of ratio of their corresponding sides,

Hence, for similar triangles ΔABC and ΔADE,

⇒ area(ΔABC)/area(ΔADE) = (AB/AD)2

⇒ area(ΔABC)/4 = (5x/2x)2

⇒ area(ΔABC)/4 = 25/4

⇒ area(ΔABC) = 25 sq. cm.

∴ Area of quadrilateral BDEC = area of ∆ABC – area of ∆ADE = 25 – 4 = 21 sq. cm.

questions.question: The 3rd and 8 th term of an arithmetic progression are -14 and 1 respectively. What is the 11th term?
questions.questionHtml: The 3rd and 8th term of an arithmetic progression are -14 and 1 respectively. What is the 11th term?
questions.solution:
The nth term of an AP with first term ‘a’ and difference ‘d’ = a + (n – 1)d

3rd term = a + 2d = -14     ----(1)

8th term = a + 7d = 1      ----(2)

Subtracting (1) from (2), we get,

⇒ a + 7d – a – 2d = 1 + 14

⇒ 5d = 15

⇒ d = 3

Substituting in (2),

⇒ a = 1 – 21 = -20

∴ 11th term = a + 10d = -20 + 10(3) = -20 + 30 = 10

questions.question: If cos θ = 35/37, then what is the value of cot θ?
questions.questionHtml: If cos θ = 35/37, then what is the value of cot θ?
questions.solution:
Using trigonometric identities,

sin2 θ = 1 – cos2 θ = 1 – (35/37)2 = 144/1369

⇒ sin θ = √(144/1369) = 12/37

∴ cot θ = cos θ/sin θ = (35/37)/(12/37) = 35/12

questions.question: If a person walks at 12 km/hr instead of 10 km/hr, he would have walked 1 km more in the same time. What is the actual distance (in kms) travelled by him at 10 km/hr in the same time?
questions.questionHtml: If a person walks at 12 km/hr instead of 10 km/hr, he would have walked 1 km more in the same time. What is the actual distance (in kms) travelled by him at 10 km/hr in the same time?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

When time is constant, the distance travelled is directly proportional to the speed (D ∝ S).

Ratio of speeds = 10 : 12 ⇒ 5 : 6.

Ratio of distances = 5 : 6.

Difference in distance = 6 − 5 = 1 unit.

According to the question, 1 unit = 1 km, so actual distance = 5 units = 5 km.

∴ The correct answer is 5 km.

Alternate Method

Given:

Actual speed = 10 km/hr

New speed = 12 km/hr

Difference in distance = 1 km

Formula:

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Let the actual distance travelled be D km.

⇒ Time taken at 10 km/hr = D ÷ 10

⇒ Time taken at 12 km/hr = (D + 1) ÷ 12

⇒ Since the time is the same in both cases:

⇒ D ÷ 10 = (D + 1) ÷ 12

⇒ 12 × D = 10 × (D + 1)

⇒ 12D = 10D + 10

⇒ 12D − 10D = 10

⇒ 2D = 10

⇒ D = 10 ÷ 2 = 5 km

∴ The correct answer is 5 km.

Additional Information

Relationship between Speed, Distance and Time

Speed is defined as the rate at which an object covers distance. Formula: Speed = Distance ÷ Time.

Direct Proportionality Case

When Time is constant, Distance (D) is directly proportional to Speed (S). Ratio formula: D1/D2 = S1/S2.

Inverse Proportionality Case

When Distance is constant, Speed (S) is inversely proportional to Time (T). Ratio formula: S1/S2 = T2/T1.

Average Speed Formula

If a person covers the same distance at two different speeds x and y, the Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y).

∴ The correct answer is 5 km.

questions.question: What is the equation of the line perpendicular to the line 2x + 3y = -6 and having Y-intercept 3?
questions.questionHtml: What is the equation of the line perpendicular to the line 2x + 3y = -6 and having Y-intercept 3?
questions.solution:
Given:

A line is given 2x + 3y = -6

Y-intercept is 3

Calculations:

According to the question, we have

A line with slope ‘m’ is represented as: y = mx + c

Given line, 2x + 3y = -6

⇒ y = (-2/3)x – 2

Slope of line = -2/3

The product of the slope of perpendicular lines is -1,

Slope of required line = -1/(-2/3) = 3/2

Equation of line is

⇒ y = (3/2)x + c

Given y-intercept = 3,

Putting x = 0, y = 3,

⇒ 3 = c

⇒ y = (3/2)x + 3

⇒ 2y = 3x + 6

∴ Equation of required line is 3x – 2y = -6

questions.question: The sum of a fraction and 4 times its reciprocal is 13/3. What is the fraction?
questions.questionHtml: The sum of a fraction and 4 times its reciprocal is 13/3. What is the fraction?
questions.solution:
Let the fraction be ‘x’

⇒ x + 4/x = 13/3

⇒ 3x2 + 12 = 13x

⇒ 3x2 – 13x + 12 = 0

⇒ 3x2 – 9x – 4x + 12 = 0

⇒ 3x(x – 3) – 4(x – 3) = 0

⇒ (x – 3)(3x – 4) = 0

⇒ x = 3, 4/3

∴ The fraction is 4/3

questions.question: If a wholesaler, sells a tin of coffee at Rs 528 he faces a loss of 12%. Now if he decides to sell it at Rs. 636, what will be the profit (in %)?
questions.questionHtml: If a wholesaler, sells a tin of coffee at Rs 528 he faces a loss of 12%. Now if he decides to sell it at Rs. 636, what will be the profit (in %)?
questions.solution:
When selling price = Rs. 528, loss = 12%

∵ Cost price – loss = Selling price

⇒ CP – 12% of CP = 528

⇒ 0.88CP = 528

⇒ Cost price = 528/0.88 = Rs. 600

∵ Selling price = Cost price + Profit

∴ When selling price is Rs. 636, profit = [(636 – 600)/600) × 100 = 6%

questions.question: Albert invested an amount of x rupees in a fixed deposit scheme offering 10% per annum for 1st year and 15% per annum for 2 nd year and received an amount of Rs. 20,240 after the two years. What is x (in Rs.)?
questions.questionHtml: Albert invested an amount of x rupees in a fixed deposit scheme offering 10% per annum for 1st year and 15% per annum for 2nd year and received an amount of Rs. 20,240 after the two years. What is x (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
∵ Simple interest = (Principal × Rate × Time)/100

For first year, Principal = Rs. x, Rate = 10%

Amount after first year = x + (x × 10 × 1)/100 = Rs. 1.1x

For second year, Principal = Rs. 1.1x = Rate = 15%

Amount after second year = 1.1x + (1.1x × 15 × 1)/100 = Rs. 1.265x

⇒ 1.265x = 20240

∴ x = 20240/1.265 = Rs. 16000

questions.question: If A's wealth is 4/9 times of B's and C's is 7/6 times of B's, what is the ratio of C's wealth to A's?
questions.questionHtml: If A's wealth is 4/9 times of B's and C's is 7/6 times of B's, what is the ratio of C's wealth to A's?
questions.solution:
A’s wealth = 4/9 × (B’s wealth)       ----(1)

C’s wealth = 7/6 × (B’s wealth)       ----(2)

Dividing (2) by (1),

⇒ C’s wealth/A’s wealth = (7/6)/(4/9) = 21/8

∴ Ratio of C’s wealth to A’s wealth = 21 ∶ 8

questions.question: The discount offered on a Shirt of Rs. 500 and a pair of Trousers of Rs 1000 is 20% and 40% respectively. If Ajay bought 2 Shirt and 3 pair of Trousers then what was the effective discount (in %) he received?
questions.questionHtml: The discount offered on a Shirt of Rs. 500 and a pair of Trousers of Rs 1000 is 20% and 40% respectively. If Ajay bought 2 Shirt and 3 pair of Trousers then what was the effective discount (in %) he received?
questions.solution:
∵ Selling price = Marked price – Discount

Marked price of 1 shirt = Rs. 500

Selling price of 1 shirt = 500 – 20% of 500 = Rs. 400

Marked price of a pair of trousers = Rs. 1000

Selling price of a pair of trousers = 1000 – 40% of 1000 = Rs. 600

Marked price of 2 shirts and 3 pairs of trousers = 2(500) + 3(1000) = Rs. 4000

Selling price of 2 shirts and 3 pairs of trousers = 2(400) + 3(600) = Rs. 2600

Total discount = 4000 – 2600 = Rs. 1400

∴ Effective discount = (1400/4000) × 100 = 35%

questions.question: A, B and C can do a job working alone in 6, 9 and 18 days respectively. They all work together for 1 day, then A and B quit. How many days C working alone will take to complete the remainder of the job?
questions.questionHtml: A, B and C can do a job working alone in 6, 9 and 18 days respectively. They all work together for 1 day, then A and B quit. How many days C working alone will take to complete the remainder of the job?
questions.solution:
A’s 1 day work = 1/6

B’s 1 day work = 1/9

C’s 1 day work = 1/18

Let C alone worked for ‘x’ days

∵ A and B worked only for one day and C worked for (x + 1) days,

⇒ A’s 1 day work + B’s 1 day work + C’s (x + 1) days’ work = 1

⇒ 1/6 + 1/9 + (x + 1)/18 = 1

⇒ (x + 1)/18 = 13/18

⇒ x + 1 = 13

⇒ x = 13 – 1 = 12

∴ C worked alone for 12 days

questions.question: A man wills 40% of his wealth to his wife and rest to his children. What percent of the wealth willed to the wife do the children get?
questions.questionHtml: A man wills 40% of his wealth to his wife and rest to his children. What percent of the wealth willed to the wife do the children get?
questions.solution:

Wealth willed to wife = 40% of x = 0.4x

Wealth for children = x – 0.4x = 0.6x

∴ Required percentage = (0.6x/0.4x) × 100 = 150%

questions.question: What is the diameter (in cm) of a sphere of surface area 6.16 sq cm?
questions.questionHtml: What is the diameter (in cm) of a sphere of surface area 6.16 sq cm?
questions.solution:
Surface area of a sphere with radius ‘r’ = 4πr2

Given, surface area = 6.16 sq. cm

⇒ 4πr2 = 6.16

⇒ r2 = 0.49

⇒ r = √0.49 = 0.7 cm

∴ Diameter of sphere = 2r = 2(0.7) = 1.4 cm

questions.solution:
The correct answer is to meet

Key Points\

  • Propose + gerund means suggest. In this formulation, it has the same meaning as when followed by a that-clause.
  • Examples
  • John proposed going to the debate.
  • I propose that we buy a smaller car.
  • I propose buying a smaller car.
  • Propose + infinitive means intend or offer.
  • Examples
  • The Government proposes to bring in new laws.
  • I propose to finish this meeting tomorrow.
  • He proposed to go so I didn't have to.
  • Janet has proposed to take notes and circulate them afterwards.​​

Here, 'propose' is used in the sense of offering to meet at the temple, so it should be followed by 'to'.

The correct sentence is: ‘He proposed to meet me at the temple’.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 2.

Key Points

  • The word "atrocious" means something extremely bad or unpleasant; it can describe something horrifyingly wicked or of very poor quality. (भयानक)
    • Example: The weather was so atrocious that we decided to stay indoors all day.
  • "Atrocious" is correctly spelt and is used to describe something shocking or dreadful. (भयानक)
    • Example: The crime scene was so atrocious that it left everyone in shock.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

questions.question: In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'. Father was upset (1)/when he found that (2)/you are not there. (3)/No Error (4)
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'. 

Father was upset (1)/when he found that (2)/you are not there. (3)/No Error (4)
questions.solution:
Ans: 3

Sol: Since the first part of the sentence uses ‘was’, it makes the sentence into simple past tense. Sentence 3 must also be in the past tense to make the sentence grammatically correct. The correct sentence is: ‘Father was upset when he found that you were not there.’

questions.question: severe problems, ________________ from anxiety disorders to depression
questions.questionHtml: severe problems, ________________ from anxiety disorders to depression
questions.solution:
Ans: ranging

Sol: Ranging means to vary between specific limits. It fits the sentence appropriately as the sentences defines the limits as anxiety disorders and depression and states that primary care physicians can be trained to detect disease in those limits. Hence, ‘ranging’ is the correct option.

questions.question: In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'. Freedom fighters laboured (1)/ to the good of (2)/the poor enslaved masses.(3)/No Error (4)
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'. 

Freedom fighters laboured (1)/ to the good of (2)/the poor enslaved masses.(3)/No Error (4)
questions.solution:
Ans: 2

Sol: The word ‘laboured’ means something done with great difficulty and effort. It is followed by a ‘for’, and not ‘to’. The phrase ‘for the good of’ means for the benefit of. The sentence talks about how the freedom fighters took great efforts to benefit the poor enslaved masses. The correct sentence is: ‘Freedom fighters laboured for the good of the poor enslaved masses.’
